segments.contextAfter: A coder instructs the object to do so by invoking [`encode(with:)`](nscoding/encode(with:).md) or [`init(coder:)`](nscoding/init(coder:).md). [`encode(with:)`](nscoding/encode(with:).md) instructs the object to encode its instance variables to the coder provided; an object can receive this method any number of times. [`init(coder:)`](nscoding/init(coder:).md) instructs the object to initialize itself from data in the coder provided; as such, it replaces any other initialization method and is sent only once per object.
